# ============================================================
# Species distribution classification with island-category sensitivity
# ============================================================
#
# Main purpose:
# This script overlays BirdLife bird range maps with mainland polygons and the
# updated global island vector. It calculates how much of each species'
# breeding/resident native range overlaps continental mainland and different
# island masks.
#
# Main island definition:
#   Use only oceanic islands and land-bridge islands.
#   Exclude polygons classified as mainland islands.
#
# Sensitivity analysis:
#   In addition to the all-island result, calculate a stricter island mask that
#   excludes ice-covered islands and Arctic islands.
#
# Main overlap areas:
#   1. continental mainland
#   2. included islands = oceanic islands + land-bridge islands
#   3. oceanic islands
#   4. land-bridge islands
#   5. non-ice and non-Arctic included islands
#
# Input data on the server:
#   BOTW_2025.gpkg
#     BirdLife range maps.
#
#   global_islands_rli.gpkg, layer global_islands_rli
#     Updated island layer.
#     category separates oceanic_is, land_bridg, and mainland_i polygons.
#     oceanic_is and land_bridg are used as the island mask.
#     mainland_i polygons are excluded from island-area analysis.
#     ice separates ice-covered and non-ice islands.
#     Arctic_isl marks islands falling inside the Arctic region.
#
#   GlbIslands.gdb, layer Mainlands
#     Mainland polygons used to calculate mainland overlap area.
#
# Output:
#   One CSV per SLURM array job with species-level areas and classification.
#   An additional CSV contains area-failed species.
#
# Notes:
#   The script runs as a SLURM array. Each task processes a subset of species.
#   All areas are calculated in EPSG:6933, a global equal-area projection.
# ============================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Spatial processing settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Skip GDAL polygon organization to speed up reading complex polygon data.
Sys.setenv(OGR_ORGANIZE_POLYGONS = "SKIP")

# Use planar geometry because all area calculations are done after projection
# to a global equal-area CRS.
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Print warnings immediately. This is useful when checking SLURM log files.
options(warn = 1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. File paths and output folders
# ------------------------------------------------------------

project_dir <- path.expand("~/island_bird_project")

bird_path <- file.path(project_dir, "BOTW_2025.gpkg")
mainland_gdb <- file.path(project_dir, "GlbIslands.gdb")
island_gpkg <- file.path(project_dir, "global_islands_rli.gpkg")
island_layer <- "global_islands_rli"

out_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "output")
chunk_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "global_island_category_sensitivity_chunks")

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(chunk_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# EPSG:6933 = World Cylindrical Equal Area.
# Area values are converted from m2 to km2 after this projection.
equal_area_crs <- 6933

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. BirdLife filters and SLURM array settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# BirdLife filters:
# presence = 1 keeps extant ranges.
# origin = 1 keeps native ranges.
# seasonal = 1 and 2 keep resident and breeding ranges.
# Small mainland overlaps can come from boundary mismatch or coastline precision.
mainland_tol_km2 <- 1

array_id <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID", "1"))
species_per_job <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SPECIES_PER_JOB", "100"))
chunk_size <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("CHUNK_SIZE", "10"))

# Calculate which subset of species this array job should process.
offset_n <- (array_id - 1) * species_per_job
job_label <- sprintf("job%03d", array_id)

log_msg <- function(...) {
  message(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), " | ", ...)
}

if (!file.exists(bird_path)) stop("BirdLife GeoPackage not found: ", bird_path)
if (!file.exists(island_gpkg)) stop("Island GeoPackage not found: ", island_gpkg)
if (!dir.exists(mainland_gdb)) stop("Mainland geodatabase not found: ", mainland_gdb)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Read BirdLife range polygons for this array job
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Inner query:
#   Selects the species assigned to this SLURM array job.
#
# Outer query:
#   Reads all BirdLife range polygons for those selected species.
bird_query <- paste0("
  SELECT sisid, sci_name, presence, origin, seasonal, geom
  FROM all_species
  WHERE presence = 1
    AND origin = 1
    AND seasonal IN (1, 2)
    AND sisid IN (
      SELECT sisid FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT sisid
        FROM all_species
        WHERE presence = 1
          AND origin = 1
          AND seasonal IN (1, 2)
        ORDER BY sisid
        LIMIT ", species_per_job, "
        OFFSET ", offset_n, "
      )
    )
")

log_msg("Reading BirdLife data for ", job_label)

birds_features <- st_read(
  dsn = bird_path,
  query = bird_query,
  quiet = FALSE
)

if (nrow(birds_features) == 0) {
  log_msg("No species assigned to this array job. Exiting.")
  quit(save = "no", status = 0)
}

# Remove empty geometries, repair invalid geometries, and transform to the
# equal-area CRS before calculating any areas.
birds_features <- birds_features[!st_is_empty(birds_features), ] %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(equal_area_crs)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Dissolve BirdLife polygons by species
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# BirdLife may contain multiple range polygons for the same species.
# This function combines all polygons belonging to one species into one
# species-level geometry.
dissolve_species <- function(species_polygons) {
  species_id <- species_polygons$sisid[1]
  scientific_name <- species_polygons$sci_name[1]

# First attempt: dissolve polygons using st_union().
  dissolved_geometry <- tryCatch(
    st_union(st_geometry(species_polygons)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

# Fallback: st_buffer(0) sometimes repairs topology problems, then union again.
  if (is.null(dissolved_geometry)) {
    repaired_polygons <- tryCatch(st_buffer(species_polygons, 0), error = function(e) NULL)

    if (!is.null(repaired_polygons)) {
      dissolved_geometry <- tryCatch(
        st_union(st_geometry(st_make_valid(repaired_polygons))),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
    }
  }

  if (is.null(dissolved_geometry)) return(NULL)

  dissolved_geometry <- st_make_valid(dissolved_geometry)

# st_make_valid() or st_union() can sometimes return a geometry collection
# containing polygons, lines, or points. Only polygons are useful for area
# calculation, so keep polygon components only.
  if (!inherits(dissolved_geometry, "sfc_POLYGON") &&
      !inherits(dissolved_geometry, "sfc_MULTIPOLYGON")) {
    dissolved_geometry <- st_collection_extract(dissolved_geometry, "POLYGON")
  }

  dissolved_geometry <- dissolved_geometry[!st_is_empty(dissolved_geometry)]
  if (length(dissolved_geometry) == 0) return(NULL)

  st_sf(
    sisid = species_id,
    sci_name = scientific_name,
    geometry = dissolved_geometry,
    crs = st_crs(species_polygons)
  )
}

birds_species <- split(birds_features, birds_features$sisid) %>%
  lapply(dissolve_species) %>%
  Filter(Negate(is.null), .) %>%
  do.call(rbind, .) %>%
  st_make_valid()

# Total range area is calculated after dissolving each species.
birds_species$total_range_area_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(birds_species)) / 1e6

log_msg("Species after dissolve: ", nrow(birds_species))

rm(birds_features)
gc()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Read updated island and mainland layers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Read the island layer, remove empty geometries, repair geometries, and
# transform to the same equal-area CRS as the species ranges.
island_all <- st_read(island_gpkg, layer = island_layer, quiet = FALSE)

island_all <- island_all %>%
  .[!st_is_empty(.), ] %>%
  mutate(
    ice = as.integer(ice),
    arctic_isl = as.integer(Arctic_isl)
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(equal_area_crs)

log_msg("Island polygons total: ", nrow(island_all))
log_msg("Included island polygons, oceanic + land-bridge: ",
        sum(island_all$category %in% c("oceanic_is", "land_bridg"), na.rm = TRUE))
log_msg("Excluded mainland-island polygons: ",
        sum(island_all$category == "mainland_i", na.rm = TRUE))
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Calculate island overlap areas by mask type
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Four island masks are calculated with the same direct code below.
masks <- list(
  included_island_area = island_all %>%
    filter(category %in% c("oceanic_is", "land_bridg")),
  oceanic_island_area = island_all %>%
    filter(category == "oceanic_is"),
  landbridge_island_area = island_all %>%
    filter(category == "land_bridg"),
  non_ice_non_arctic_island_area = island_all %>%
    filter(
      category %in% c("oceanic_is", "land_bridg"),
      ice == 0,
      arctic_isl == 0
    )
)

area_results <- vector("list", length(masks))
area_names <- paste0(names(masks), "_km2")

for (mask_index in seq_along(masks)) {
  current_mask <- masks[[mask_index]]
  current_area_name <- area_names[mask_index]
  log_msg("Calculating ", current_area_name, "...")

  spatial_hits <- st_intersects(birds_species, current_mask)
  overlapping_species_rows <- which(lengths(spatial_hits) > 0)

  species_chunks <- split(
    overlapping_species_rows,
    ceiling(seq_along(overlapping_species_rows) / chunk_size)
  )
  chunk_area_results <- vector("list", length(species_chunks))

  for (chunk_index in seq_along(species_chunks)) {
    log_msg(
      "Calculating ", current_area_name,
      " chunk ", chunk_index, " / ", length(species_chunks)
    )

    species_rows <- species_chunks[[chunk_index]]
    species_chunk <- birds_species[species_rows, ]
    mask_rows <- unique(unlist(spatial_hits[species_rows]))

    overlap_geometry <- tryCatch(
      st_intersection(species_chunk, current_mask[mask_rows, ]),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(overlap_geometry)) {
      chunk_area_results[[chunk_index]] <- data.frame(
        sisid = species_chunk$sisid,
        area_km2 = NA_real_
      )
      next
    }

    overlap_geometry <- st_collection_extract(overlap_geometry, "POLYGON")
    overlap_geometry <- overlap_geometry[!st_is_empty(overlap_geometry), ]

    if (nrow(overlap_geometry) == 0) {
      chunk_area_results[[chunk_index]] <- data.frame(
        sisid = species_chunk$sisid,
        area_km2 = 0
      )
      next
    }

    species_area_chunk <- overlap_geometry %>%
      mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 1e6) %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      group_by(sisid) %>%
      summarise(area_km2 = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    chunk_area_results[[chunk_index]] <- data.frame(sisid = species_chunk$sisid) %>%
      left_join(species_area_chunk, by = "sisid") %>%
      mutate(area_km2 = coalesce(area_km2, 0))
  }

  area_results[[mask_index]] <- bind_rows(
    bind_rows(chunk_area_results),
    data.frame(
      sisid = setdiff(
        birds_species$sisid,
        birds_species$sisid[overlapping_species_rows]
      ),
      area_km2 = 0
    )
  )
  names(area_results[[mask_index]])[2] <- current_area_name
}

included_island_area <- area_results[[1]]
oceanic_island_area <- area_results[[2]]
landbridge_island_area <- area_results[[3]]
non_ice_non_arctic_island_area <- area_results[[4]]

rm(masks, area_results)

rm(island_all)
gc()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Calculate mainland overlap area
# ------------------------------------------------------------

log_msg("Reading mainland polygons...")
mainlands <- st_read(mainland_gdb, layer = "Mainlands", quiet = FALSE)
mainlands <- st_sf(geometry = st_geometry(mainlands), crs = st_crs(mainlands)) %>%
  .[!st_is_empty(.), ] %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(equal_area_crs)

log_msg("Calculating mainland area...")
mainland_spatial_hits <- st_intersects(birds_species, mainlands)
mainland_overlapping_species_rows <- which(lengths(mainland_spatial_hits) > 0)

if (!length(mainland_overlapping_species_rows)) {
  mainland_area <- data.frame(
    sisid = birds_species$sisid,
    mainland_area_km2 = 0
  )
} else {
  mainland_species_chunks <- split(
    mainland_overlapping_species_rows,
    ceiling(seq_along(mainland_overlapping_species_rows) / chunk_size)
  )
  mainland_chunk_area_results <- vector("list", length(mainland_species_chunks))

  for (chunk_index in seq_along(mainland_species_chunks)) {
    log_msg(
      "Calculating mainland area chunk ", chunk_index,
      " / ", length(mainland_species_chunks)
    )

    species_rows <- mainland_species_chunks[[chunk_index]]
    species_chunk <- birds_species[species_rows, ]
    mainland_rows <- unique(unlist(mainland_spatial_hits[species_rows]))

    overlap_geometry <- tryCatch(
      st_intersection(species_chunk, mainlands[mainland_rows, ]),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(overlap_geometry)) {
      mainland_chunk_area_results[[chunk_index]] <- data.frame(
        sisid = species_chunk$sisid,
        area_km2 = NA_real_
      )
      next
    }

    overlap_geometry <- st_collection_extract(overlap_geometry, "POLYGON")
    overlap_geometry <- overlap_geometry[!st_is_empty(overlap_geometry), ]

    if (nrow(overlap_geometry) == 0) {
      mainland_chunk_area_results[[chunk_index]] <- data.frame(
        sisid = species_chunk$sisid,
        area_km2 = 0
      )
      next
    }

    mainland_area_chunk <- overlap_geometry %>%
      mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 1e6) %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      group_by(sisid) %>%
      summarise(area_km2 = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    mainland_chunk_area_results[[chunk_index]] <- data.frame(sisid = species_chunk$sisid) %>%
      left_join(mainland_area_chunk, by = "sisid") %>%
      mutate(area_km2 = coalesce(area_km2, 0))
  }

  mainland_area <- bind_rows(
    bind_rows(mainland_chunk_area_results),
    data.frame(
      sisid = setdiff(
        birds_species$sisid,
        birds_species$sisid[mainland_overlapping_species_rows]
      ),
      mainland_area_km2 = 0
    )
  )
}

rm(mainlands)
gc()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Build final species-level table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Vectorised helper used for both main and sensitivity classifications.
classify_land_distribution <- function(island_area, mainland_area, island_prop, mainland_prop, failed) {
  case_when(
    failed ~ "area_failed",
    island_area > 0 & mainland_area <= mainland_tol_km2 & island_prop >= 0.99 ~ "Island species",
    mainland_area > 0 & island_area <= mainland_tol_km2 & mainland_prop >= 0.99 ~ "Continent species",
    island_area > 0 & mainland_area > 0 ~ "Island-continent shared",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

species_result <- birds_species %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(sisid, sci_name, total_range_area_km2) %>%
  left_join(mainland_area, by = "sisid") %>%
  left_join(included_island_area, by = "sisid") %>%
  left_join(oceanic_island_area, by = "sisid") %>%
  left_join(landbridge_island_area, by = "sisid") %>%
  left_join(non_ice_non_arctic_island_area, by = "sisid") %>%
  mutate(
# Land area for the main analysis includes mainland plus included islands
# (oceanic + land-bridge). Mainland-island polygons are not counted here.
    land_area_all_islands_km2 = mainland_area_km2 + included_island_area_km2,

# Land area for the sensitivity analysis includes mainland plus only
# non-ice and non-Arctic included islands.
    land_area_non_ice_non_arctic_km2 = mainland_area_km2 + non_ice_non_arctic_island_area_km2,

# Island proportion relative to terrestrial area in the main analysis.
    included_island_prop_land = ifelse(
      land_area_all_islands_km2 > 0,
      included_island_area_km2 / land_area_all_islands_km2,
      NA_real_
    ),

# Island proportion relative to terrestrial area in the non-ice non-Arctic
# sensitivity analysis.
    non_ice_non_arctic_island_prop_land = ifelse(
      land_area_non_ice_non_arctic_km2 > 0,
      non_ice_non_arctic_island_area_km2 / land_area_non_ice_non_arctic_km2,
      NA_real_
    ),

# Island-only proportions, useful for checking whether a species' island
# range is mainly oceanic, land-bridge, ice-covered, or Arctic.
    oceanic_prop_included_island = ifelse(
      included_island_area_km2 > 0,
      oceanic_island_area_km2 / included_island_area_km2,
      NA_real_
    ),
    landbridge_prop_included_island = ifelse(
      included_island_area_km2 > 0,
      landbridge_island_area_km2 / included_island_area_km2,
      NA_real_
    ),
    any_area_failed = is.na(mainland_area_km2) |
      is.na(included_island_area_km2) |
      is.na(oceanic_island_area_km2) |
      is.na(landbridge_island_area_km2) |
      is.na(non_ice_non_arctic_island_area_km2),

# Main analysis: oceanic + land-bridge islands, including ice and Arctic.
    land_distribution_class_all_islands = classify_land_distribution(
      island_area = included_island_area_km2,
      mainland_area = mainland_area_km2,
      island_prop = included_island_prop_land,
      mainland_prop = 1 - included_island_prop_land,
      failed = any_area_failed
    ),

# Sensitivity analysis: only non-ice and non-Arctic oceanic/land-bridge islands.
    land_distribution_class_non_ice_non_arctic = classify_land_distribution(
      island_area = non_ice_non_arctic_island_area_km2,
      mainland_area = mainland_area_km2,
      island_prop = non_ice_non_arctic_island_prop_land,
      mainland_prop = 1 - non_ice_non_arctic_island_prop_land,
      failed = any_area_failed
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(land_distribution_class_all_islands, mainland_area_km2, included_island_area_km2, sci_name)

# Tables for quick checks.
area_failed_species <- species_result %>%
  filter(any_area_failed)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Write output tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fwrite(
  species_result,
  file.path(chunk_out_dir, paste0("all_species_island_category_sensitivity_", job_label, ".csv"))
)

fwrite(
  area_failed_species,
  file.path(chunk_out_dir, paste0("area_failed_species_", job_label, ".csv"))
)

log_msg("Analysis finished.")
log_msg("Output folder: ", chunk_out_dir)
